messages.author: b4bad0e184a76164
messages.subject: segmentation faul in pystan - ODE solving
parts:
Hi everyone,


I was trying to solve a very simple differential equation using rstan and pystan.

Based on the examples in the manual I made a very simple example (see files attached).

The code I came up with runs perfectly in rstan, no warnings.
But when trying to do the same exercise in pystan I get a segmentation fault.

I am using Ubuntu 14.04, python 2.7 and stan 2.9.0

Any help on this would be deeply appreciated.

cheers
emille
